translation.name: In yancuic mononotzalistli ica Totecohtzin Jesucristo

book.name: SAN MATEO
book.title: IN YANCUIC TLAHTOLI ICA JESUCRISTO QUEN OQUIHCUILUI IN TETIOTLATITLANIL MATEO

content: In ichichicacoluan Totecohtzin Jesucristo
Ica inin tlahcuilolamatl techmatiltiyahque in ichichicacoluan in Totecohtzin Jesucristo, quen Yehhuatzin in ichichicaixuiu in David huan noyojqui den Abraham.
In Abraham iconeu in Isaac huan in Isaac iconeu in Jacob, huan in Jacob iconehuan in Judá huan oc sequin icnihuan.
In Judá iconehuan in Fares huan in Zara, huan in inana itoca Tamar. Huan in Fares iconeu in Esrom, huan in Esrom iconeu in Aram.
In Aram iconeu in Aminadab, huan in Aminadab iconeu in Naasón, huan in Naasón iconeu in Salmón.
In Salmón iconeu in Booz huan in inana itoca Rahab. In Booz iconeu in Obed huan in inana itoca Rut. Huan in Obed iconeu in Isaí.
In Isaí iconeu in hueyixtoc David, huan in David iconeu in Salomón ica in inana aquin achto inamic in Urías.
In Salomón iconeu in Roboam, huan in Roboam iconeu in Abías, huan in Abías iconeu in Asa.
In Asa iconeu in Josafat, huan in Josafat iconeu in Joram, huan in Joram iconeu in Uzías.
In Uzías iconeu in Jotam, huan in Jotam iconeu in Acaz, huan in Acaz iconeu in Ezequías.
In Ezequías iconeu in Manasés, huan in Manasés iconeu in Amón, huan in Amón iconeu in Josías.
In Josías iconehuan in Jeconías huan oc sequin icnihuan, ipan inon tonalten queman oquinuicaque tlatemactilten ipan in tlali Babilonia.
Satepa de inon, in Jeconías iconeu in Salatiel, huan in Salatiel iconeu in Zorobabel.
In Zorobabel iconeu in Abiud, huan in Abiud iconeu in Eliaquim, huan in Eliaquim iconeu in Azor.
In Azor iconeu in Sadoc, huan in Sadoc iconeu in Aquim, huan in Aquim iconeu in Eliud.
In Eliud iconeu in Eleazar, huan in Eleazar iconeu in Matán, huan in Matán iconeu in Jacob.
In Jacob iconeu in José, inamic in María, huan yehhua in inana in Jesús, yehhua in tetoca Cristo.

Ijcon opanoc mahtlactli huan nahui ololten omopatlaque den Abraham hasta in David, huan oc mahtlactli huan nahui ihcuac oquinuicaque in israeltecos ipan in tlali Babilonia, huan oc mahtlactli huan nahui ihcuac yotlacatihuac in Cristo.
In tenetlacatilis in Jesucristo

In tenetlacatilis in Totecohtzin Jesucristo ijquin ocatca. In María yomotemacatoya ihuan motlalis in José. Huan ic yesquiyanihque sansecnin, yehhua yoquipixtoya in iconeu ica in ichicahualis in Itiotonaltzin Dios.
In José se tlacatl molui tlamelajcan. Ahmo oquinec quitemactis maquinmiyacamatican ica in María. Oquinec quicahua san ichtaca, ahmo maquimatican in tlacamen.

Huan ic oquinehnehuili inon, se ángel oquimocochnextili huan oquiluic: ―José, ixuiu in David, ahmo ijcon xicchiconehnehuili ic ticselis quen mosihuau in María, tleca in conetl tehuaxca in Itiotonaltzin Dios.
In María quiitas se iconeu, huan tictocahhuis Jesús, tleca Yehhuatzin quinmaquixtilos in techantlacahuan ica intlahtlacol.
Inin opanoc ic matzonquisa quen Totecohtzin oquitlahtoltiloc in tlayolchicauqui itoca Isaías:

content.text: In ichpochtli quipiyas se iconeu, huan quitocahhuisque Emanuel,

content: tlen quihtosnequi: Dios tohuan ilohuas.
Ihcuac in José ocochihsac, oquichiu quen in ángel oquitequiuti, huan ocuicac in María quen isihuau.
Huan oquipiyaya san quen itetlaihtla huan ahmo ihuan omotlali hasta otlacat in achto iconeu, huan oquitocahhui Jesús.
